title: Index writes retry when the database is busy
eli5: When the database is briefly locked, saving now waits and tries again instead of failing straight away. If it is still locked after three tries, it gives up with a clear error.

units.title: Index writes retry when the database is busy
units.risk_reason: Changes error contract callers depend on
units.brief: Commit used to fail on the first lock clash. It now [[retries up to three times with growing waits]], then returns ErrIndexBusy. [[The wait ignores cancellation]], so a cancelled request still sleeps. [[No test forces the busy path]].

notes.note: Counts 0 to 2. Ranging over an integer needs Go 1.22 or newer.
Only a busy error retries. Wrapped busy errors also match.
Blocks the whole wait. Cancelling ctx cannot interrupt it.

checks.detail: Commit tries up to three times with 50, 100, 200 ms waits, then returns ErrIndexBusy.

checks.criterion: Cancelling a request stops index work
checks.detail: Between attempts the code sleeps without watching ctx, so a cancelled request still waits up to 350 ms.

checks.criterion: Busy path is covered by a test
checks.detail: No test makes the database busy, so the retry and final ErrIndexBusy never run under test.

blast.title: Callers see a new error
blast.detail: sync.flush treats any Commit error as fatal, so a busy index will now stop a sync with ErrIndexBusy.

ask: Replace time.Sleep with a select on a timer and ctx.Done(), as the index README asks.
Add a test that forces sqlite3.ErrBusy and expects three attempts, then ErrIndexBusy.
units.question: Should a cancelled request still wait out the retry sleeps?

units.title: README documents retry and cancellation
units.brief: Adds two lines saying [[writers stop when ctx is done]] and retry three times. The first claim is not true yet.

watch_after_deploy: Rate of ErrIndexBusy in sync logs

story.why: Index writes failed outright whenever SQLite reported a brief lock clash, so syncs died on busy databases.
story.what: Commit now retries a busy database up to three times with growing waits, then reports a clear ErrIndexBusy. The index README documents retries and cancellation.
story.before: A lock clash failed the write at once with the raw database error.
story.after: A lock clash is retried for up to 350 ms, then fails with ErrIndexBusy.

impact.change: Fewer failed syncs when the index is briefly locked.
Callers now see ErrIndexBusy instead of the raw sqlite error.
A cancelled request can still sleep up to 350 ms between retries.

focus: Whether retries must stop when the request is cancelled
How sync.flush treats the new ErrIndexBusy
